consensus_summary: The consensus understands marriage and the bride as symbolizing the covenantal union between God (or Christ) and His people (Israel in the Old Testament, the Church in the New Testament).
book_summary: The book defines marriage/bride as the covenant union of God and His people, a one-flesh bond established by God.
consensus_core_identification: The covenant union between God/Christ and His people/the Church.
book_core_identification: The covenant union of God and His people.
rationale: Both the book and the consensus identify the core meaning of marriage and the bride as the covenantal union between God and His people. The scripture references provided by both (e.g., Ephesians 5, Revelation 19, Ezekiel 16) exactly mirror one another.
